Markets.title: Deepa Jewellers sets IPO price band at Rs 168-177; Rs 460 crore issue opens Sept 1
Markets.summary: Deepa Jewellers has set its Rs 460 crore IPO price band at Rs 168 to Rs 177 per share. The subscription period runs from September 1 to September 3, with shares scheduled to list on September 8.

Markets.title: Global Market: Kospi gains over 1% as Nvidia outlook lifts chipmakers
Markets.summary: South Korean shares rose 1.22%, led by chipmakers Samsung Electronics and SK Hynix following Nvidia's strong AI revenue forecast. The Bank of Korea also raised interest rates by 25 basis points to 3% and upgraded its 2026 growth forecast to 3.3%.

Markets.title: 4 smallcaps with up to 332% PAT growth just surged 170%: Can the outperformance continue?
Markets.summary: Smallcap stocks recently surged 170% and led Nifty-500 earnings growth with a 35% year-over-year increase in the first quarter of fiscal year 2027. While strong domestic inflows and themes like power support the rally, investors should remain selective due to high valuations and narrowing market breadth.

Markets.title: Gold prices up Rs 1,300/10 grams; silver rebounds Rs 3,400/kg as falling oil eases rate cut bets. Buy, sell or hold?
Markets.summary: MCX gold and silver prices rose sharply on Thursday, driven by softer oil prices, a weaker dollar, and US Federal Reserve policy expectations. Investors are now closely awaiting upcoming remarks from Fed Chair Kevin Warsh at Jackson Hole for further direction.

Markets.title: Oil Price Today (August 27): Crude oil dips to $87, down for 4th session amid Hormuz reopening hopes. What are experts saying?
Markets.summary: Crude oil prices fell for the fourth consecutive session on Thursday, with Brent dropping to $87.24 and WTI declining to $81.67 a barrel. The price decrease was driven by growing optimism that diplomatic efforts involving Iran and Oman could lead to the reopening of the Strait of Hormuz and ease supply concerns.

Markets.title: Nvidia investors beware: Firm flags 2 risks after better-than-expected Q2 earnings
Markets.summary: Despite strong Q2 earnings, Nvidia warned investors that rising memory costs and growing debt are key emerging risks. The chipmaker expects its gross margins to drop to 71–72% by the fourth quarter of fiscal 2027.

Geo-Political.title: Heart, hope and a steely determination: Dolly Parton's musical legacy
Geo-Political.summary: BBC music correspondent Mark Savage reflects on the musical legacy of the late singer Dolly Parton. He highlights her as an irreplaceable artist defined by heart, hope, and steely determination.

Geo-Political.title: Door was locked at Pakistan hospital where fire killed 14 babies, witnesses say
Geo-Political.summary: Witnesses state that the door of a Pakistan hospital ward was locked during a fire that killed 14 babies. The hospital denies this, claiming security guards manned the unlocked door to protect the infants.

Geo-Political.title: Trump officials threaten Kennedy Center demolition if court blocks renovations
Geo-Political.summary: Trump officials are threatening to demolish the Kennedy Center if a court blocks its ongoing renovations. The Justice Department has also requested that Donald Trump's name be restored to the building following its removal in June.

Geo-Political.title: At least 12 dead as wildfires sweep through northern Algeria
Geo-Political.summary: At least 12 people have died as severe wildfires sweep through northern Algeria. The blazes are a result of severe heatwaves that have caused hundreds of fires across North Africa this summer.

Geo-Political.title: US drug agency approves breakthrough treatment for pancreatic cancer
Geo-Political.summary: The United States drug agency has approved daraxonrasib as a new treatment for pancreatic cancer. Experts have hailed the medication as a significant breakthrough for one of the world's deadliest forms of the disease.

Geo-Political.title: At least one dead after car crashes into crowd in northern France
Geo-Political.summary: One person died after a car crashed into a crowd in Caen, northern France, following a fight at a nearby bar. Police arrested one suspect in connection with the incident.

Data & Insights.summary: Federal Reserve Chair Kevin Warsh faces the challenge at Jackson Hole of reassuring markets about his commitment to controlling inflation. He must achieve this without increasing pressure on the bond market.

Data & Insights.title: Egg prices up nearly 40%, may get more expensive this winter due to ethanol production: Here’s how
Data & Insights.summary: Egg prices in India have surged 35% to 40% over the past year, with retail prices currently reaching up to ₹9 per egg. Prices are expected to rise further this winter due to increased seasonal demand and ethanol production factors.

Data & Insights.title: India’s GDP growth likely slowed to a 4-quarter low of 7.4% in Q1: Mint poll
Data & Insights.summary: A recent Mint poll indicates that India's GDP growth likely slowed to a four-quarter low of 7.4% in the first quarter. While industrial and services sectors supported the economy, agricultural activity was hindered by a delayed monsoon.

Data & Insights.title: Mint Explainer: Why does Niti Aayog want to change India’s skilling system?
Data & Insights.summary: Niti Aayog has proposed combining India's education and training into a single system to prepare workers for future jobs by 2047. This new framework shifts the focus of skilling programs from basic certification to guaranteed employment.

Data & Insights.title: How India’s import dependence is spilling beyond oil, in charts
Data & Insights.summary: India’s non-petroleum trade deficit is surging beyond crude oil due to a growing reliance on foreign imports. This rising dependence on electronics components and industrial inputs highlights that the country focuses more on assembly than deep manufacturing.

Data & Insights.title: VCs look past payment figures to spot 'dead users' hiding in UPI autoPay metrics
Data & Insights.summary: Venture capitalists are examining UPI autoPay metrics to distinguish between real app usage and dormant subscribers. This analysis helps investors determine the actual value of startups as transaction volumes increase.

India.title: IP University Introduces Online BBA, B.Com Courses; More Courses Coming
India.summary: Guru Gobind Singh Indraprastha University has launched online BBA and BCom degree programs starting in September. Admissions for these new online courses are currently open, with additional programs planned for the future.

India.title: Delhi Model, 21, Stabbed To Death Inside Home. Her Gym Trainer Is Accused
India.summary: A 21-year-old model was stabbed to death inside her Delhi home. Her gym trainer, Imran, is the accused in the attack and remains at large.

India.title: NDTV World 'Anviksha' India-Nepal Dialogue Live Updates: Event To Bring Together Politicians, Diplomats, Business Leaders
India.summary: NDTV World is hosting the 'Anviksha' India-Nepal Dialogue in Kathmandu to discuss relations between the two countries. The live event brings together politicians, diplomats, and business leaders.

India.title: UP TET Result 2026 Released; Direct Link To Download Scorecard
India.summary: UPESSC released the UP TET 2026 results on August 26. Candidates can download their scorecards from the official website using their login credentials.

India.title: Haryanvi Singer, YouTuber Ankit Balyan Shot Dead Outside Gym In UP
India.summary: Haryanvi singer and YouTuber Ankit Balyan was shot dead outside a gym in Uttar Pradesh's Shamli district. Police are currently investigating the incident to determine the motive and identify the attackers.

India.title: Nepal Floods: 32-Member Kolkata Group Among Many From West Bengal Untraceable
India.summary: A 32-member group from Kolkata is among 133 Indian nationals missing following flash floods in central Nepal. The disaster, which originated in Tibet, has left more than 100 people dead and over 750 missing.

General.title: BBC visits hospital in Kathmandu as families wait for news
General.summary: Over 150 people were killed by a massive flash flood on the Nepal-Tibet border, leaving hundreds still missing. BBC reporters visited a hospital in Kathmandu where families are waiting for news.

General.title: Woman who died in fire with niece, 7, was 'beautiful soul', mother tells BBC
General.summary: Two men have been arrested on suspicion of murder following a house fire in Middlesborough that killed a woman and her seven-year-old niece. The victim's mother told the BBC that her daughter was a "beautiful soul."

General.title: New thunderstorm warnings for parts of UK as rain set to continue
General.summary: The Met Office has issued new thunderstorm warnings for England and Wales on Thursday. The unsettled weather brings a potential risk of flash flooding.

General.title: Meta's $18bn settlement may hasten reckoning for social media on child safety
General.summary: Meta faces an $18 billion settlement over child safety concerns. This legal action could lead to stricter regulations and a reckoning for the social media industry.

General.title: At least one dead after car crashes into crowd in northern France
General.summary: One person was killed when a car crashed into a crowd in Caen, northern France. Police arrested a suspect following the incident, which occurred after a fight at a nearby bar.

General.summary: Without brain surgery guided by live AI assistance, Rhys Hibbert could have lost his sight to a tumour.
